# speechv1

```go
import speechv1 "pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/llm/speech/v1"
```

Package speechv1 is the llm.speech/v1 contract: a model reads text aloud.

A wire contract at /api/\_c/llm.speech/v1. In pb\_hooks it's $llm.speech.

Source: [`ext/contracts/llm/speech/v1`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/contracts/llm/speech/v1).

## Functions

### OnModels

```go
func OnModels(owner any, fn func(e *extkit.CallEvent, in *llm.ModelsInput) error)
```

OnModels binds fn to models calls on owner (an app, or a host's scope for calls the host answers). Call e.Next() to continue; return an error to refuse. in is the call's input; changes reach the provider.

## Types

### Client

```go
type Client struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Client is llm.speech/v1 over HTTP, for the CLI and other apps. It implements Speech; the token it was made with is the credential, so the extkit.Auth argument is ignored.

### NewClient

```go
func NewClient(baseURL, token string, hc *http.Client) *Client
```

NewClient calls llm.speech/v1 on the app at baseURL with token (a PocketBase auth token or an API token).

### Result

```go
type Result struct {
	File  llm.File  `json:"file"`
	Model string    `json:"model"`
	Usage llm.Usage `json:"usage"`
}
```

Result is the audio.

### SpeakInput

```go
type SpeakInput struct {
	Model string `json:"model"` // "provider/model", required
	Text  string `json:"text"`
	Voice string `json:"voice,omitempty"`
	// Format is the audio format: mp3 (default), wav, opus, flac, pcm, as the provider allows.
	Format string  `json:"format,omitempty"`
	Speed  float64 `json:"speed,omitempty"`
	// Instructions describe the delivery ("slow and calm, a bedtime voice"), for models that take them.
	Instructions string      `json:"instructions,omitempty"`
	Options      llm.Options `json:"options,omitempty"`
}
```

SpeakInput is what to say and how.

### Speech

```go
type Speech interface {
	// Speak reads the text aloud and returns the audio.
	//
	//op: POST speak
	Speak(ctx context.Context, a extkit.Auth, in SpeakInput) (Result, error)
	// Voices lists a model's voices, when the provider says.
	//
	//op: POST voices scope=llm:read
	Voices(ctx context.Context, a extkit.Auth, in VoicesInput) (VoiceList, error)
	// Models lists the speech models of every provider in Settings → LLM.
	//
	//op: GET models scope=llm:read
	Models(ctx context.Context, a extkit.Auth, in llm.ModelsInput) (llm.Models, error)
}
```

Speech turns text into audio.
